evals.prompt: design the cache layer for our CLI — we keep re-fetching the same registry metadata on every run. I'm torn between sqlite and a flat-file json cache, maybe there's a third option. walk me through tradeoffs and land on one.
evals.expected_output: Propose-then-critique loop over named alternatives, converged draft persisted to designs/<slug>.md, SPEC.md untouched.
expectations: A new file exists under designs/ with a kebab-case slug related to caching
The draft file contains a decision among explicitly named alternatives (sqlite, flat-file json, and any third option raised)
The draft file's Open Questions section is empty or absent at persist time
SPEC.md is byte-identical before and after the run (git status shows no SPEC.md change)
The final response ends with a '## Next' block of 1-5 items
The '## Next' block offers folding the draft via /sdd:spec designs/<slug>.md
